items.question: What pure locus is established at the center of the milk-ocean?
premises: A locus is situated in the middle of the milk-ocean.
This locus is characterized as a white lotus expanse.
The milk-ocean center serves as the setting for this pure form.
items.inference: A white lotus expanse abides as a pure locus within the center of the milk-ocean.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of vistaram as object of an implied perception or presence is unstated in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: A white lotus expanse situated in the middle of the milk-ocean.
